title: Machine Run key autostarts
whyItMatters: Programs in this key start for every user. It reveals machine-wide agents that may keep data in sync on the handed-over PC.
source: Microsoft Learn, Run and RunOnce registry keys: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/setupapi/run-and-runonce-registry-keys
notes: Machine-wide autostart list. Value data is never read and registry last-write time is unavailable (D3). The 32-bit view is not queried.
